about: McMaster 2361A61 hardened V-blocks with screw clamps, a composed pair (one mesh, no colours): the blocks hardened and ground bright all over; the U-clamps and their knurled screws black oxide.
reviewed: 2026-11-05: natural, materials and parts sheets (look/vblock_*.png); page check checks/vblock_*_before_after.png

rules.why: the U-shaped clamp straps (60 x 13 x 51 mm)
the clamp screws (43 mm long, 10 mm across)
the clamps' retaining cap screws, standing above the blocks' 50.8 mm tops: the part finder joins them to the blocks, so by height

download_why: the pair's hard-edged CAD keeps 26k vertices at the 12k-triangle cap (every sharp edge splits them): 451 KB of geometry before any AO; a 512 AO adds 74 KB. A 256 AO would fit the 0.5 MB class at ~1.7 mm a texel, blurring the holes and clamps
